# vue-mcp-apps

> Write MCP Apps (the `io.modelcontextprotocol/ui` extension of the Model Context Protocol, spec 2026-01-26) as plain Vue 3 components with Nuxt UI. The same component renders natively in your Vue/Nuxt app (`<McpCard>`) and sandboxed inside any MCP Apps host (Claude, VS Code, Goose, ChatGPT) via `startMcpApp`. A server kit registers `ui://cards/<name>` templates on MCP SDK v1 or v2; a Vite plugin builds all cards into one self-contained `cards.json`. A playground tests cards in three layers (host → sandbox proxy → view, on the official `AppBridge`) and an in-browser AI demo (Chrome built-in AI, WebLLM, OpenAI-compatible, scripted) shows real tool calls producing cards in a chat.

Key rules: a card's buttons can only do what its manifest declares (actions are data); tools only a card may call use `visibility: ['app']`; everything crossing `postMessage` must be plain JSON; templates fetch nothing.

Single-file version of all docs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/llms-full.txt

## Guides

- [Integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/INTEGRATION.md): cards package, MCP server (SDK v1/v2, stdio, Node http, Express, fetch handlers), Nuxt 4 and Vue apps, your own chat UI, real hosts, CI, migrating a hand-rolled card system
- [Writing cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/WRITING_CARDS.md): rules and step-by-step for card authors
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): card contract, result shape, view runtime, native runtime, server kit, bundle format, theming, security model
- [Playground](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/PLAYGROUND.md): the three layers, controls, inspector, fixtures, hot reload, using it with your cards
- [AI demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/AI_DEMO.md): providers, decision protocol and JSON schema, safety, adding a provider
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/TESTING.md): unit, protocol conformance vs AppBridge, server kit vs SDK, bundle freshness, Playwright through the iframes, official Inspector
- [CI/CD](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/main/docs/CI_CD.md): workflows, GitHub Pages, npm release with provenance
